summary: Stomatal coordinates are openly available for Arabidopsis (a polygonal-celled case, 66 plants, CC0), and a CC0 Dryad set holds stomata-annotated images of 450 monocot leaves (rice, barley, sugarcane), but no dataset combines stomatal positions with epidermal cell shape on the same leaves across oblong- and polygonal-celled species; the claim's named species (hyacinth, Sedum) were not found in any dataset checked.
